head: WORKTREE
summary: Post and release reuse the T-027 consumer, inbox and UC2 write path via one move(); creditor-side refusals roll back whole and are recorded with the inbox mark; release is never refused. All four criteria are proven by named unit and Kafka+PostgreSQL IT tests, including transit-back-to-previous and redelivery with a marker message.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: PaymentTransfersIT#redeliveredPostTransferHasNoSecondEffect, #redeliveredReleaseFundsHasNoSecondEffect; single listener and inbox path in LedgerCommandListener
transitBalance() equals transitBefore after post and after release in PaymentTransfersIT
